title: Late Data Feed Impact on Daily Score
dataSources: Cross-stream correlations (`correlation:pair`), anomaly-day rollups (`anomalyday:score`), personal SLA checks (`personalsla:status`), and daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`).
app: Meta-monitoring for every `index=personal` stream, turning cross-signal correlations, anomaly-day scoring, and personal SLA dashboards into Splunk-native analytics.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifescore:daily
| search life_score=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(life_score) as avg_life_score by _time late_feed_flag
| sort - _time
description: Tracks daily life score after late feeds over time and breaks it out by late-feed flag.
value: This split helps you see whether score instability comes from life changes or simply data arriving too late.
implementation: Send daily life score after late feeds events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of daily life score after late feeds by late-feed flag.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how daily life score after late feeds changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
